claims.promise: Reads the microtonal makam intervals (komma and perde offsets from equal temperament) in cents and holds a stable lock on the thick low saz and oud courses instead of reporting silence or freezing.

evidence.finding: com.visne.oudtuner (4.1 stars, 2,970 reviews) draws 'Accuracy is very bad. Only 2 available tunings for free', and com.baglamatuner (4.2 stars, 2,560 reviews, 1M+) draws 'Not detecting any sounds' and 'This app freez and dont hear my saz'.

claims.deferredReason: No slot exists yet; the pitch-detection path and its unit tests are written at implementation time.

claims.promise: No advertisement can interrupt a tuning session: the app is bought once and shows no full-screen, interstitial or banner ad over the tuner, ever.

evidence.finding: 7 of 13 critical reviews on the baglama tuner shelf were ad complaints (54%), and com.visne.oudtuner is hit 'with full screen ads every 30 seconds that are not only annoying, but also cau[sing]'.

claims.deferredReason: No slot exists yet; the paid archetype and the absence of the ads capability are implemented at scaffold time.

evidence.finding: com.visne.oudtuner's own review text says 'Only 2 available tunings for free, the rest is paid', and Perfect Tuner (4.1 stars, 87,501 reviews) 'ambushes you with a $15 a week subscription every time you try to use it'.

claims.promise: The tuner works fully offline and never asks for an account or a sign-in, so it reads pitch in a lesson room, a rehearsal cellar or a village wedding where there is no signal.

evidence.finding: com.golfbpm.golfbpmapp (3.5 stars, 34 reviews) is criticised because it 'Makes you create an account and doesn't even offer a free version', and an offline complaint appears on Pro Guitar Tuner (143,610 reviews).

claims.deferredReason: No slot exists yet; the offline-by-construction design and the absence of any network permission are enforced at implementation time.

claims.deferredReason: No slot exists yet; the tone generator and the perde reference are built after the detector is proven.
